combined_progress.interpretation: Saved responses are generation progress, not validated benchmark scores. Stale or missing health reports make current counts unverified. Selected runs are disjoint; historical responses are counted once.

deployment_status.description: Observed both four-A100 hosts processing unchanged native requests on vLLM0.32.0. Each GPU has64 bounded HTTP requests with128 server sequence capacity and95% GPU memory allocation; automatic per-host health, combined progress and native CPU scoring watches are active. Startup CPU/RAM inheritance errors were corrected before any scored request on that host. All original responses remain unchanged.

queue_policy.rationale: 64 outstanding HTTP requests per GPU attained the measured short-input maximum (1026.2 output tokens/s vs651.2 at32 and973.6 at128). Medium and 4096-output sweeps were approximately flat at32 vs64 (232.2 vs230.8;605.8 vs588.5). Use a deep mixed-work queue without client fractional reservations or head-of-line drain; vLLM owns actual KV admission. Internal recomputation is retained and included in measured throughput. This is a serving choice from synthetic work, not model-quality tuning or a full-suite speedup claim.
